name: Leon
backstory:
Leon is one of Cazador's spawn and Astarion's 'siblings'. Before he was a slave, he was a Sorcerer, and is also the father of Victoria.

Cazador forced Leon to bring Victoria to the palace, and ever since he has tried to keep the position of Favoured Spawn so they could stay together in the 'favoured spawn' bedchamber. He organised an escape for Victoria, but she was later brought back to the palace where she was killed by Dalyria.

Leon and Victoria's belongings can be found in the favoured spawn bedchamber, including Leon's diary and Victoria's .
